supporting_observations.claim: At 13:49:22 UTC, WS-MSANTOS-01 had a 7-second TCP connection to the internal proxy at 10.54.20.30:8080 with 51,000,317 bytes sent from the workstation and 8,896 bytes received. This is consistent with a large upload through the proxy.
The available connection record identifies the internal proxy, not the ultimate destination or application. It does not establish what data was sent or whether the transfer was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: Collection-status metadata reports that WS-MSANTOS-01 winsec and sysmon logs, and PROXY-BLU-01 proxy logs, were not collected from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC due to an outage; this metadata has no record IDs.
Zeek connection telemetry is reported as available for all hosts, but the supplied record for the large transfer contains no ultimate destination or application attribution.
claims_not_established: The record does not establish the ultimate external destination, URL, or service for the transfer (T199-00239).

The record does not establish which process or user initiated the transfer, what files or data were transferred, or whether the transfer was an approved OneDrive or other business activity (T199-00239).

The alert describes activity around 13:46 UTC, while the supplied large-transfer connection is timestamped 13:49:22 UTC; the evidence does not establish whether these refer to the same underlying event (T199-00239).
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain PROXY-BLU-01 transaction logs for the event to identify the destination, URL, HTTP method, and any available user or application attribution.
Obtain endpoint process and file activity for WS-MSANTOS-01 around 13:49 UTC, including any available EDR telemetry.
Check Microsoft 365/OneDrive audit and sync records, and relevant user or business records, to determine whether a transfer of this size was expected.
unrelated_findings: WS-MSANTOS-01 started Palo Alto GlobalProtect PanGPS.exe as SYSTEM at 13:23:13 UTC (T199-00028, T199-00029). Given the inventory context that the organization has no VPN, validate this software separately; the supplied records do not link it to the alerted transfer.
